legacy_refs.title: P30 I01 cadence and binding floor (BIND-*)
legacy_refs.description: Bootstraps the meta-gate and shift-left prevention every later P30 iter runs under, mechanizing the one rule: never ship an idle contract again. A wave is done only when its contract is BOUND to a real call path with a binding-proof test that asserts it fires and a negative-path test that asserts it blocks when violated. This is a binding iter, not a build iter: it wires already-built contracts onto the paths they were specified for and proves they fire. Ten waves, 13.5 EU.
